% A test for tex8web: a class without \abstract or \contentsname, which
% tex8web must not assume (the checks are the build's own).
\documentclass{letter}
\signature{Someone}
\address{A street\\ A town}
\begin{document}
\begin{letter}{Another\\ Elsewhere}
\opening{Dear Another,}
A letter with math, $x^2 + y^2 = z^2$.
\closing{Yours,}
\end{letter}
\end{document}
